limits: Read-only probe: no gameplay actions or UI input are invoked.
Actual home transform and FOV are recorded; the provisional shoulder pose is not assumed.
Slate callback sampling does not guarantee observing every game tick. Analyzer must check world-time gaps before summing clamped delta times.
UIOnly video input can consume host key events before PlayerController key-state queries. Host Actions remain separate evidence.
